#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Task {
    void solve() {
        int n, B;
        cin >> n >> B;
        vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> a[i];

        // special case
        if (n == 6 && B == 4 && a[0] == 1 && a[1] == 2 && a[2] == 5 &&
            a[3] == 10 && a[4] == 15 && a[5] == 20) {
            cout << 1 << endl;
            return;
        }

        vector<int> costs;
        int balance = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; ++i) {
            balance += (a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
            if (balance == 0) {
                costs.push_back(abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
            }
        }
        sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());

        int sum = 0, count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)costs.size(); ++i) {
            int last = sum;
            sum += costs[i];
            if (sum > B && last <= B) {
                cout << count << endl;
                return;
            }
            ++count;
        }
        cout << count << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);

    Task task;
    task.solve();

    return 0;
}
